topography.project_purpose: Restaking. Structurally: 25 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 1 ERC4626 vault, 4 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 12 common project-authored base contract(s) (erc20upgradeable, contextupgradeable, reentrancyguardupgradeable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
